note: A string applies at every viewport; an object is keyed by viewport width. 'page' holds the page-level findings (selector 'body'). 'variants' lists the 200% text-scale pass (ids end in -200). Fonts assume macOS or Windows (Arial installed).

#fallback.note: First family 'Agent Manuel Missing Font' is not installed; Arial painted.

#webfont-failed.note: @font-face 'Broken Webfont' points at a missing file (status error); Arial painted.

#local-face.note: @font-face 'Fixture Sans' loaded from local(Arial); the painted name differs but the face loaded.

#mono.note: Monospace is excluded from the family count.

#caption-13.note: Deliberately small caption: a lead on phones, fine on desktop, never a fail.

#sr-hint.note: Visually hidden 10px screen-reader text: skipped, and its 1px overflow box is not 'clipped'.

#long-lines.note: No max-width: ~169 characters per line at 1280px, ~48 at 390px.

#clipped-ellipsis.note: 160px nowrap cell with ellipsis; the text needs ~291px.

#fits-ellipsis.note: Same ellipsis cell, but the text fits.

#clamp-fits.note: Same clamp, one line of text.

#badge-fixed.note: Fixed 32px-high badge: fits at 100%, clips at 200% (see variants).
